description: Wallets that belong to the founder, left out of the paid-call counts in `pnpm evidence:summary`. A payment where one of these is the payer, the payee or the signing key is not counted. The list is empty until the founder adds their wallets; nothing is guessed. Change it only by adding a new history entry with a higher version.

history.note: Created empty. The founder adds their own wallets, with a label each, and raises the version.
